description: Single-file vertical space shooter: scrolling starfield, 4+ enemy types with distinct movement/fire patterns, wave scripting, power-ups, boss fight with phases, health/shield, particles, screen shake, pause, high score in localStorage.

criteria: space_shooter_model_01.html is one self-contained vertical shooter (no libraries): a scrolling starfield, at least 4 enemy types with genuinely different movement and firing patterns, scripted waves that escalate, at least 3 power-ups that change the weapon or defense, a multi-phase boss with health bar and attack patterns, player health/shield with invulnerability frames after hits, particle explosions and screen shake on impacts, score and localStorage high score, pause and restart, and a game-over screen. Bullets, collisions and spawns must all be real.
